svg.title: Direct invocation state: paired time and allocation
svg.desc: Seven scenarios on the same Ubuntu host and Java 17 JVM. Each side has six independent fork means. Lines span those six means, never the thirty iterations. Three candidate/baseline block ratios are shown separately. The session scenario is an unchanged negative control; ranges are not confidence intervals.

svg.text: Ubuntu 24.04 / Java 17 / 256 MiB heap / same probe JAR / one request in flight
84 fresh JVMs; three ABBA blocks; six forks per side and scenario.
Dots: fork means / line: fork range / diamond: mean of six forks
UNCHANGED SESSION PATH / NEGATIVE CONTROL ONLY
Paired C/B: candidate block mean / baseline block mean; values show blocks 1 / 2 / 3.
Observed fork and block ranges are not confidence intervals. Iterations are nested within forks.
Time and B/op include the harness and exact oracle. Media constructors and codecs are not timed.
